collection.description: A patient asks the healer whether recovery is likely, while the family begs the healer to offer only hope.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A patient asks the healer whether recovery is likely, while the family begs the healer to offer only hope.

choices.label: Tell the patient what is known and uncertain.
Offer reassurance without discussing the prognosis.
Ask how much the patient wants to know.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient thanks the healer and chooses how to spend their remaining time.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient is frightened at first but later appreciates the honesty.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The patient senses something is being withheld and becomes distrustful.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The family feels relieved, but the patient asks harder questions.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The patient requests every detail before deciding on treatment.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The patient prefers a brief explanation and asks the healer to speak with family afterward.
